items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013
items.q: Betty Carter used to say that people forget this music is still about entertainment.

ctx.x: It was bass with Pat Metheny. You know and Pat came after that and did a master class for us, and it was great. In fact, that student that I said that he was not happy with me is now playing bass with Pat Metheny. And so now we have a great relationship you know. But I just told him, I said, “Listen man, the music requires you guys to be accountable. You can be upset with me all you want, you can call your momma and tell her I’m jive or whatever you want to do.” “But,” I said, “the music requires us to be…
The life lessons that the Art Blakey generation passed on, I’ve heard referenced many times. Now you’re a generation or two beyond him, and your life lessons are different.
